name: Range drone: breaks away from a fighter that closes in

notes: The range's manoeuvring drone: it tracks the nearest air contact; inside 9 km of it, every period (2 s) it either breaks 90° or turns away from it, at random, so its flight path keeps changing; farther away it flies its route. It never shoots.
notes.rules[1]: 9 km: a little beyond the gun's and the short-range missile's reach, so the drone is already manoeuvring when the shot comes (inferred)
